2:2.text: and he is the expiation for our sins, and not for ours only but also for the sins of the whole world.

3:16.text: By this we know love, that he laid down his life for us; and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

3:18.text: Little children, let us not love in word or speech but in deed and in truth.

4:19.text: We love, because he first loved us.

4:18.text: There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear. For fear has to do with punishment, and he who fears is not perfected in love.

4:7.text: Beloved, let us love one another; for love is of God, and he who loves is born of God and knows God.
4:7.notes: Agrees word for word with the RSVCE entry (bible-history.com). Ch. 11, 2026-10-06.

4:8.text: He who does not love does not know God; for God is love.
4:8.notes: Agrees word for word with the RSVCE entry (bible-history.com). Ch. 11, 2026-10-06.
